description: Questions that need detailed, multi-part or multi-article reasoning over the illustrative demo articles (data/demo_articles.json). expected_sources are article source files; with require_all_expected every listed article must be cited. min_words / max_words check that answer length fits the question; must_mention lists phrases a correct grounded answer has to contain. Answers are saved in the report for manual review.
